card.name: Digits inside statistics and percentages
card.fires_on: Digits or decimal points partway through a number in a reported statistic, such as a percentage, rate or measured value. Also the word "estimated" before an incidence rate.

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: A digit or decimal point in the middle of a percentage, count or measurement.
modes.example: Gastrointestinal: Duodenitis, gastritis, pancreatitis (1.<<3>>%) Musculoskeletal and Connective T

modes.label: The word estimated
modes.description: The word "estimated" right before an incidence rate in trial results.
modes.example: the<< estimated>> incidence rate of suicidal behavior or ideation

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly pushes toward words like estimate and background and away from code-style tokens.
